title: Knowing but Not Saying: Preventing Factual Access Failures in LLM SFT via Recall-Anchored Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can degrade factual behavior outside the target domain. This degradation is often described as catastrophic forgetting, yet open-ended factual failures do not necessarily imply that the underlying facts have been erased. In this work, we identify a more specific phenomenon, factual access failure: after domain SFT, models can still recognize or rank the correct answer under constrained evaluation, while failing to produce it in closed-book generation. Through benchmark-level comparisons, same-fact multiple-choice and generation probes, and failure-mode analysis, we show that SFT-induced factual degradation reflects both genuine wrong-answer generations and expression-level failures such as verbosity, formatting mismatch, and exact-match artifacts. To address this problem, we introduce Recall-Anchored Distillation (RAD), a base-anchored self-distillation objective that preserves out-of-distribution generation

translated_title: 知道却不说：通过召回锚定蒸馏防止大语言模型SFT中的事实访问失败
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20794v1 公告类型：新 摘要：监督微调（SFT）可能会在目标领域之外降低事实行为。这种退化常被描述为灾难性遗忘，但开放式的事实失败并不一定意味着底层事实已被抹去。在本工作中，我们识别出一个更具体的现象，即事实访问失败：在领域SFT后，模型在受限评估下仍能识别或排序正确答案，但在封闭式生成中却无法生成它。通过基准级比较、同事实多项选择和生成探针以及失败模式分析，我们表明SFT引发的事实退化既反映了真正的错误答案生成，也反映了表达层面的失败，如冗长、格式不匹配和精确匹配伪影。为解决此问题，我们引入了召回锚定蒸馏（RAD），一种基于锚定的自蒸馏目标，以保持分布外生成能力。
tldr: 本文发现监督微调导致的事实退化主要源于“事实访问失败”而非知识擦除，并提出召回锚定蒸馏（RAD）方法，通过锚定基础模型的自蒸馏来保持分布外生成能力。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that SFT-induced factual degradation stems primarily from "factual access failure" rather than knowledge erasure, and proposes Recall-Anchored Distillation (RAD), a base-anchored self-distillation objective to preserve out-of-distribution generation.
